title.de: Der Deckel macht, was er will

deck.ko: 뚜껑이 삐뚤어졌네 — 맑은 해안의 가벼운 미니멀.
deck.en: Steadying a blue cup with a sideways grin in a sunny coastal lane.
deck.de: Der Deckel macht, was er will — ein leichter Minimal-Look an der Küste.

intro.ko: 파란 컵의 뚜껑을 바로잡다가 카메라와 눈이 마주쳤어요. 아이보리 셔츠와 네이비 바지는 그 짧은 장난을 편하게 받아 줍니다.
intro.en: Fixing the blue cup lid turns into a shared grin with the camera. An ivory shirt and navy trousers keep the little interruption easy.
intro.de: Beim Richten des blauen Becherdeckels entsteht ein verschmitzter Blick in die Kamera. Elfenbeinfarbenes Hemd und marineblaue Hose bleiben dabei entspannt.

tip.ko: 셔츠와 바지는 두 가지 색으로만 묶고 토트는 셔츠와 같은 크림 톤으로 맞춰, 컵의 파랑만 튀게 두세요.
tip.en: Keep the outfit to two tones and match the cream tote to the shirt, so only the blue cup stands out.
tip.de: Den Look auf zwei Töne beschränken und den cremefarbenen Shopper zum Hemd passen lassen – so sticht nur der blaue Becher heraus.

copy.pullQuoteEn: A small tilt, a shared grin.

deck.en: The lid has other ideas — an easy minimal moment by the coast.

tip.ko: 셔츠 밑단을 내어 입고 칼라를 가볍게 열어, 컵을 잡을 때 어깨가 편하게 움직이도록 하세요.
tip.en: Wear the hem untucked and the collar open so the shoulders move freely while you steady the cup.
tip.de: Den Saum locker über der Hose und den Kragen offen tragen, damit die Schultern beim Halten des Bechers frei bleiben.

sourceCopy.reason: b190 review: en deck repeated the English article title; tip was identical to the first product how-to-wear on screen.
